outcome: large for gestational age at birth
cohort: A cohort of 4,069 unselected nulliparous women was studied.
finding: Diagnosis of GDM is preceded by excessive growth of the fetal abdominal circumference between 20 and 28 weeks gestational age, and these effects are additive with maternal obesity.
birth_weight: Large for gestational age at birth was an outcome.
gest_age: Fetal biometry was measured at 20 and 28 weeks of gestational age, and GDM diagnosis occurred at or after 28 weeks of gestational age.
